description: This file defines the interface for 'sampleChMessage', an extension of a 'message' object used in a sample channel. It includes type definitions, function prototypes, and data structures for creating, destroying, and handling formatted messages with support for XML and JSON payloads.

methods.name: createSampleMessage
methods.description: Creates a blank message and initializes its userData with a sampleMessage object.

methods.name: destroySampleMessage
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a sampleMessage object, excluding the parent message container.

methods.name: extractSampleMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the sampleMessage object from a message's userData.
